The operating time should

Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
testing procedures P1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by 
M6 in the above title block.
This procedure, details the 
steps required to completely check the proper operation and calibration of the 
relay ( D21Se3 ).
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Mahmoud El-Attar, accepted 
by eng. Saad 
El-Attar: protection 
general manager, revised and certified by eng. Mohamed Omran: development & quality 
surveillance general manager 
and MPIS Canal zone coordinator, and 
approved by eng. Al-Saied Abd El-Azez Alnagy: head sector of protection, measuring & 
testes.

Precautions
